Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

centre noun

the middle

also center, middle, in the middle, in the middle of, midst, central, in the centre

classical

Phaedr. 3.14.5: in mediā viā
Plaut. Curc. 4.1.14: in forō mediō (Lewis & Short)

medius, media, medium

adjective

in the middle; the middle of

Latin says “the middle road” for “the middle of the road”: in mediā viā; the town centre is media urbs (see town centre).

Examples

  • arcum retēnsum posuit in mediā viā

    he laid the unstrung bow down in the middle of the roadPhaedr. 3.14.5

  • candidus in mediō favus est

    in the middle is a white honeycombOv. Met. 8.677

  • item esse hominēs sub eādem regiōne caelī ūnum oculum in frontis mediō habentēs, quī appellantur Arimaspī

    and that under the same part of the sky there are men with one eye in the middle of the forehead, who are called ArimaspiansGell. 9.4.6

Other words

  • medium, mediī n. — the middle, the centre

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Ov. Met. 8.677: in mediō; Liv. 1.57.9: in mediō aedium sedēns (Lewis & Short)

    As a noun of place it is rare in Cicero (Lewis & Short); the adjective is the usual way.

  • centrum, centrī n. — the centre of a circle

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Vitr. 3.1; Plin. NH 2.63 (Lewis & Short)

    Greek κέντρον, the fixed point of the compasses: a word of geometry.

  • umbilīcus, umbilīcī m. — the navel; the very centre of a place

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Cic. Verr. 2.4.106: umbilīcus Siciliae

    Henna was called the navel of Sicily because it lies in the middle of the island (Cic. Verr. 2.4.106).

  • centrālis, centrāle — central, in the centre

    also used · classical · Plin. NH 2.86 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 122: calefactiō centrālis, central heating

    Pliny’s word, of the earth at the centre of the world; Traupman uses it for central heating. For the middle of a place, Latin says medius: in mediā urbe.

See also town centre, centre, half, central heating.
